title: Complementation by flipping output
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $L$ be a language of Boolean words, and let $T\colon\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. If $N$ has total nonhalting probability at most $T(|x|)$ on every input $x$, and every run that halts outputs the one-symbol indicator of whether $x\in L$, then the machine obtained by complementing each output bit has total nonhalting probability at most $T(|x|)$ on every input and outputs the one-symbol indicator of whether $x\notin L$ on every halted run.
